result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there are a couple of visible layout issues: some restaurant content is clipped in the horizontal lists, and the lower card is partially obscured by the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" row is cut off on the right edge, with both the image and title only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal carousel spacing or card width so the next item is either fully visible or clearly indicated as scrollable without clipping important content.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section is partially hidden behind the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content area or account for the fixed bottom nav so cards are not obscured.
